 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Sono P.S. Case No. 14 of 2021, G.R.
No. 203/2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner and others defrauded and took Rs. 8 Lakhs from the informant on the pretext of selling land.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is quite innocent.

He has not committed the offence as alleged in the F.I.R. and in fact, he has been falsely Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.49978 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 implicated in this case for his no fault.
An agreement was made between the petitioner and informant.
Thereafter, the petitioner executed registered sale deed for 20 decimal land as per the instruction of his sons namely Nand Lal Yadav and Shambhu Yadav.

As such in no way the petitioner is involved in any type of cheating and forgery with the informant and as such no offence under sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the I.P.C. are made out against the petitioner in this case.
Learned counsel further submits that petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
